memory: Travel story and future vision: Traveling has become one of my core passions that I’ll continue nurturing even after graduation. I’m excited about my future in computer science and hope to land a job with remote work days or flexible scheduling, allowing me to keep exploring. Whether it’s a weekend trip to a mountain range or a flight to a different continent, I’m fully committed to staying connected to the world beyond my desk. I’m especially eager to combine my love of coding with travel—such as working abroad for a stint or collaborating on international projects. For now, I’m enjoying mentally planning the next journey as a way to unwind from debugging. This keeps me motivated and is a major reason I’m so excited about the next phase of my life.
